_about: Descriptor-only probes for the relational/flavor path. Each list of adjectives was GUESSED from the mapped test_query's summary (never from the index's real embedded descriptors). target_query_id / target_book_id say which scene-type it should surface, so a run can check whether pure-descriptor retrieval lands the same book as the summary query. weights omitted => backend applies equal weights. anti_descriptors (optional) push the search AWAY from a flavor.
